thread:
maya: quick heads-up — infra team needs a shortened deploy window this Thu (18:00-20:00 UTC) for a datacenter network firmware update. please plan around this and avoid non-urgent rollouts. :warning:
chris: acked. can we get a checklist for what counts as 'non-urgent'?
maya: good call — non-urgent = feature flags, docs-only changes, cosmetic UI tweaks, and perf experiments. urgent = P0 fixes, security patches, high-sev rollbacks.
leo: will update the release calendar and tag any in-flight minor releases so they don't start during the window.
ops-bot: scheduled maintenance: datacenter-network-fw-update (Thu 18:00-20:00 UTC). Impact: transient increased latency, potential eviction of small burst pods. Auto-fallbacks enabled.
chris: @sre-oncall can you run a quick capacity blast during the prep window tomorrow to validate autoscale behavior?
sre-oncall: yep — running a 30m soak at 18:30 UTC tomorrow. will post logs in #eng-sre.
katie: also — new embargo exception process we discussed last week is live. if you need a deploy that would normally be blocked, open the form here: https://redwood.internal/embargo-exceptions and include rollout justification + rollback plan. approvals from Eng Lead + SRE required.
maya: added: if you file an exception, include the canary percentage and a staged rollback timeline. ops will refuse manual exceptions without that info.
leo: quick snippet for CI gating changes — include this in PR description when requesting exception:
```
Embargo-Exception: true
Canary: 10%
Rollback: revert-pr-1234 within 15min
Approvers: @chris @sre-oncall
```
chris: small ask — any teams with scheduled demos Thu evening, call them out here so we can avoid surprises.
marketing: (briefly jumped in) marketing: our product demo is 19:00 UTC Thu — can we ensure the demo slot is safe?
maya: @marketing noted. We'll mark that demo as protected; no risky DB migrations during 18:30-19:30.
ops-bot: reminder: rolling back to fallback clusters will be automatic if eviction rate > 5% for 3 consecutive minutes.
sre-oncall: I'll be monitoring. will post a short post-mortem if anything degrades.
maya: thanks all. TL;DR: Thu 18:00-20:00 UTC shortened deploy window, request embargo exceptions via form, include canary+rollback. Reach out if you have planned releases that may be impacted. :thumbsup:
